guide.boltcraft_casino.about.1: A casino that players build and run themselves. The owner sets up a vault, fills it with resources and opens a cashier and games. Guests change resources for chips, play, and change their winnings back.
guide.boltcraft_casino.about.2: Every chip in a pocket is backed by resources in a vault, so no casino can print money out of thin air.
guide.boltcraft_casino.about.3: Chips are play money only. Nothing won or lost here ever leaves the Minecraft world.
guide.boltcraft_casino.about.title: About the mod
guide.boltcraft_casino.authors.1: BoltCraft Casino is part of the BoltCraft modpack family. Idea and direction: Maxim (Mbolt1337).
guide.boltcraft_casino.authors.2: Every model, texture and sound was made for this mod.
guide.boltcraft_casino.authors.title: Authors
guide.boltcraft_casino.cashier.1: The cashier changes resources for chips and back at the server's rates. The resources go into the vault the cashier is linked to.
guide.boltcraft_casino.cashier.2: Rates on this server, for one item:
guide.boltcraft_casino.cashier.3: Chips cannot be crafted. They come as 1, 10, 100 and 1000, and the cashier gives change in the largest chips it can.
guide.boltcraft_casino.cashier.title: Chips and the cashier
guide.boltcraft_casino.decor.1: Everything for your own hall: neon letters and signs, boards, marquee lights, carpets, tiles, columns, chandeliers, velvet furniture and a bar. It is cheap and waits in the "BoltCraft Casino: Decor" tab.
guide.boltcraft_casino.decor.2: A neon letter asks for its character when it is placed; just type it. A dye changes the color of the neon.
guide.boltcraft_casino.decor.3: Right-click a sofa, bar stool or dining chair with an empty main hand to sit. Press Shift to stand. Leave room in front of the seat for your legs.
guide.boltcraft_casino.decor.title: Decor
guide.boltcraft_casino.hospitality.1: Make canapes, sandwiches, berry tarts, chocolate truffles, berry fizz and spiced cocoa. They restore food; drinks return an empty bottle or ceramic cup.
guide.boltcraft_casino.hospitality.2: Put a serving tray or lamp on a counter, card table or low coffee table. A tray holds four individual servings. Right-click with food to add one; use an empty hand to take one.
guide.boltcraft_casino.hospitality.3: Shift-right-click a tray with an empty hand to pick it up with its servings dropped separately. The bar_menu item tag lets modpacks choose which foods can be served.
guide.boltcraft_casino.hospitality.title: Food and service
guide.boltcraft_casino.roulette.1: European roulette with 37 pockets, 0 to 36. Several players bet at one table until the croupier calls "No more bets!".
guide.boltcraft_casino.roulette.2: Payouts include the stake: a number ×36, a dozen ×3, red, black, even, odd, 1-18 and 19-36 ×2.
guide.boltcraft_casino.roulette.3: One bet is at most %s chips.
guide.boltcraft_casino.roulette.title: Roulette
guide.boltcraft_casino.slot_machine.1: Pick a bet and pull the lever. Three of a kind pay by the table, and so do two cherries.
guide.boltcraft_casino.slot_machine.2: Payouts on this server, in bets:
guide.boltcraft_casino.slot_machine.3: Over many spins the machine returns %s of the chips played.
guide.boltcraft_casino.support.1: Maxim makes BoltCraft Casino for the BoltCraft modpacks. If you enjoy it, you can support his work through the link below.
guide.boltcraft_casino.support.2: Support is voluntary. It gives no chips, no items and no advantage in the game.
guide.boltcraft_casino.support.title: Support the author
guide.boltcraft_casino.vault.1: The vault is the casino's bank: winnings are paid from the resources inside. Only its owner can open it.
guide.boltcraft_casino.vault.2: The manager key ties it all together: click your vault with it, then a cashier or a game.
guide.boltcraft_casino.vault.3: A vault cannot be broken while players still hold its chips. They have to be changed back first.
guide.boltcraft_casino.vault.title: The vault and the key
guide.boltcraft_casino.world.1: Abandoned casinos stand in plains, deserts, savannas and badlands: a small neon lounge, and more rarely a grand hall on two floors.
guide.boltcraft_casino.world.2: Their vaults are empty and belong to no one. Click one with a manager key and it is yours; then link the cashier and the machines, fill the vault, and the casino is open again.
guide.boltcraft_casino.world.3: Their chests hold decor, gold and sometimes a manager key, but never chips.
guide.boltcraft_casino.world.title: Casinos in the world
